item.title: Dog fouling, 5th November
item.description:
Dog fouling has become a growing concern on Hamlet Road, posing an escalating public health and safety hazard. It appears several dog owners are consistently failing to clean up after their pets, resulting in new waste appearing daily. Residents, including families with young children, frequently step in the fouling, which is entirely unacceptable. This ongoing issue violates local Dog Control Orders and Public Spaces Protection Orders (PSPOs), under which leaving dog waste in public spaces is illegal. To address this negligence and deter irresponsible owners, we urgently request increased enforcement patrolling and the installation of clearer, updated warning signage along the street. This matter requires immediate attention to restore the cleanliness and safety of our community.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 25, Hamlet Road, Crystal Palace, Greater London
